owner: 03｜技術指標與趨勢動能研究室
purpose: Freeze promotion-grade ADX/Bollinger state semantics across verified suspension, price-basis transformation, identity termination and unresolved lifecycle boundaries without changing canonical formulas.

wilderReferenceSemantics.barClock: ADX/DMI recurrence advances on the ordered eligible observed-bar sequence, not elapsed calendar days.
wilderReferenceSemantics.trueRange: On an eligible resumed bar, TR uses current H/L and the previous eligible observed bar close under the same certified price basis.
wilderReferenceSemantics.directionalMovement: DM compares the resumed bar H/L with the previous eligible observed bar H/L under the same certified price basis.
wilderReferenceSemantics.interpretation: A long closure may be a regime/context variable, but calendar duration alone does not silently change the canonical ADX formula or state transition.

cases.adxRule: Skip non-trading dates entirely. Resume with the next eligible observed bar and continue canonical Wilder recursion on eligible-bar chronology. The resumed bar TR/DM may legitimately capture a large market gap versus the last pre-suspension eligible bar.
cases.bollingerRule: No pseudo closes are inserted. The exact 20 eligible closes span around the suspension by observed-session order only.

cases.adxRule: Do not bridge RAW pre-event H/L/C directly into post-event H/L/C. Recompute ADX from the certified continuity-transformed H/L/C history, or from a replay-certified trusted prior state that is in the same transformed price space.
cases.bollingerRule: Use the certified continuity-transformed close history before mixing pre/post-event prices in one 20-session window.

cases.adxRule: Terminate old-symbol recursive state. Do not inherit ADX/Wilder state into the new symbol or market identity unless a separately versioned economic-identity continuity contract explicitly certifies equivalence and transformed history.
cases.bollingerRule: Terminate the old-symbol finite window at the identity boundary; new identity requires its own eligible-session lineage unless a separately certified identity-continuity transform exists.

cases.adxRule: No promotion-grade ADX state may be emitted.
cases.bollingerRule: No promotion-grade 20-session continuity window may be emitted.

parameterFamilyRule: Any proposed reset-after-X-calendar-days, reset-after-X-eligible-bars, decay-during-suspension, or alternate reseeding rule is a new preregistered parameter-family hypothesis and may not mutate PF_D03_ADX_CANONICAL.

warmupRule.implication: The suspension semantics do not relax the existing canonical replay/warm-up gate.

D03-09.benefit: Closes the previously under-specified restart-vs-bridge semantics for suspension/reorganization cases.

D03-10.benefit: Reconfirms suspension is an eligible-session clock issue, not a pseudo-bar or calendar-decay issue.

exactNextContinuationPoint: Keep W0 and genuine-parent tracks primary. When physical inputs arrive, apply these suspension/restart semantics inside the existing D03-09 FULL_REPLAY and D03-10 exact-20-session oracles. Independently retain raw 3-session, S2-07 stabilization, System1/System2 D03 redundancy/dedup and D16 incrementality gates.
